blocks.text: QUEZON, Bukidnon — Manobo and Talaandig ethnic groups in Quezon, Bukidnon, commemorated the 29th National Indigenous Peoples Month on Tuesday. The event was held in line with celebrations marking the anniversary of the landmark Indigenous Peoples’ Rights Act (IPRA) of 1997. The event highlighted how traditional knowledge, customary governance, and ecological stewardship continue to shape the cultural and economic identity of Quezon. For centuries, the indigenous communities of Quezon, predominantly belonging to the Manobo tribe, have lived in harmony with the land.
